The '''Xorth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xorth]]. It was noteworthy for being the source of the best [[Farrberry|farrberries]] available.
